mch_ratings(dates: 'list[str]', *, return_as_pandas: 'bool' = False) -> 'pl.DataFrame | pd.DataFrame' MCH opponent-adjusted goal-margin ratings over a set of scoreboard dates. Fetches espn_mch_scoreboard for each date in dates, concatenates the completed games, and adjusts with sportsdataverse.hockey.college_hockey_ratings.college_hockey_ratings. Parameters Returns One row per team: team_id, adj_off, adj_def, adj_net, raw_off, raw_def, games. Example from sportsdataverse.hockey.mch import mch_ratings ratings = mch_ratings(["20250118", "20250201"]) ratings.sort("adj_net", descending=True).head()
